decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - APROVE the following materials:

External walls 	
Finished in sand and cement render and painted off-white. 

Roof	
Slate grey-coloured Falzinc standing seam metal deck roofing.

Windows  	
All windows are to be white powder coated doubled glazed aluminium (permanently fixed shut) windows with two layers of 15mm glass (with blackout film) with a 32mm gap between the glazing sheets.      

The external doors	
All new external doors are to be solid core acoustic panelled doors.  The double emergency doors on the rear elevation are only to be openable internally by a push bar release system.  The single access disabled access door on the side elevation is to be operated manually from inside the building when the doorbell is rung.
description: Following approval for renewal of planning permission 00248/18-20/P10 granted on appeal 11/06/99 for the erection of single storey rear extension with associated parking to public house - details submitted pursuant to Condition 7 (Sample of materials) of approved by legal ref APP/F5540/A/03/1131548 dated 25/02/2004.
